protocol.limits_note: --limit is per-subtask in lm-eval: mmlu_pro (14 subtasks) at --limit 80 is n=1120 total. All other tasks are single-task (limit = n).
protocol.seed_note: The three hosted runs were launched with --seed only, which in lm-eval 0.4.12 seeds python/numpy/torch/fewshot but NOT the request payload (that is the --model_args seed, which defaulted to 1234 for all runs). The run-to-run spread in this card therefore reflects server-side nondeterminism, not sampler seeds. run_parity_bench.sh now passes seed into --model_args, so local runs ARE seed-independent samples.
